en: The image shows a group of uniformed soldiers, possibly officers, standing in formation with swords at their sides. They are assembled in front of a large, stone building with barred windows and a veranda, where other uniformed men are watching. The soldiers wear pickelhaube-style helmets, which are associated with late 19th to early 20th-century German and Prussian military uniforms. In the background, there are additional soldiers and horses on a parade ground.
